title: dtls13 support early data + fixes
description:
- Support 0-RTT (aka Early Data) decryption
- Fix mem leaks in tls13_generate_keys, cipher init
- Fix overflow in aad calculation
- Simplify epoch management
- Refactoring to increase code reuse

commits_data.title: dtls13: support early data and various fixes
commits_data.message:
dtls13: support early data and various fixes

- fix memleak of the sn_evp cipher

- simplify epochs management:

  - Do not try to decrypt epoch lower than the one already decrypted. This allows
    for not storing the next sequence number for each epoch, making the management
    easier. Some re-ordered or duplicate packets may not be decrypted, even if it's
    feasible.

  - Check that the epoch is incremented by one at a time. Conversations in which
    the epoch is incremented by more than one do not comply with the protocols, and
    trying to decrypt these packets may involve heavy calculations on the
    dissector. This also allows for easier key updates.

- fix mem leak in tls13_generate_keys
